current.reason: the admission gate admits no strategy for paper execution, so every cycle ends in NO_TRADE_STRATEGIC

objective_3_ops_per_day.requested: 3 operations/day, 7 days/week, multiple assets when it makes sense
blockers: no admitted strategy: the admission gate admits nothing (0 of 24)
no measured family edge clears the frozen cost floor: best family gross edge is 8.91 bps/trade against a 23.353553391 bps round trip
at 3 trips/day the strategy would pay ~255.7% of its stake in round-trip costs every year; the gross edge would have to average above the floor per trip
what_would_change_it: a new admitted hypothesis whose measured net expectancy is positive at a cadence of several trades per day after the frozen cost model
multi-asset expansion multiplies opportunity count but not per-trade edge; it does not remove the per-trade cost requirement
the decision is a governance matter (new hypothesis, new budget); this audit proposes nothing
objective_3_ops_per_day.no_forcing_note: the objective is not a quota: no operation is generated to satisfy a frequency target
